title: Oozy Sweet French Apples Tarte Tatin
description: A sweet and indulgent French dessert featuring caramelized apples and chilled butter, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot. This egg-free-friendly dish is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the sugar, flour, and salt in a small bowl.
Add the lemon juice, water, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Arrange the apple halves in the fondue pot, leaving a 1-inch space between each apple.
Dot the top of the apples with the chilled butter cubes.
Pour the sugar mixture evenly over the apples and butter.
Cover the fondue pot and steam the apples for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and caramelized.
Remove the fondue pot from the heat and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Tarte Tatin warm, topped with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired.
